mechanism: Gentamicin is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, potentially increasing ranolazine exposure since ranolazine undergoes renal excretion and is metabolized by CYP3A4 with renal clearance of metabolites.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) regularly during concurrent use; assess ranolazine dosing appropriateness if renal function declines; consider gentamicin alternatives if possible.
